patterns: APPSC asks AP-tilted direct facts: Year of Natural Farming (2018), Palekar = ZBNF, PKVY as the organic-farming initiative, NE organic states (Assam not one).
APPSC statement items on agriculture and environment: fertiliser/pesticide pollution true, monoculture harmful; 'eco-friendly practice = organic farming'.
Other PSCs ask agrochemical one-liners: zinc phosphide rat poison, copper sulphate fungicide, allethrin/prallethrin repellents, neem-coated urea slows dissolution, DAP 18-46.
Recurring keys: Sikkim first fully organic State; sunn hemp best green manure; NPOP under Commerce/APEDA (not Rural Development).
App leans on scheme statistics (NMNF figures, PM-PRANAM) and long multi-statement items beyond APPSC's depth.
